data.name: Grounding Goo*
data.description: The alchemist's bomb applies a sticky residue after any damage from the bomb is resolved. If a creature damaged by the bomb has a nonmagical fly speed, its flight is severely impaired, and it takes a -%1 penalty on Fly checks for 1 minute.|AlchemistDiscoveryLVL
